ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approx 80% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized on the distal extremities of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are located on the distal ends of both lobes. On the left lobe, an irregular white geometric blob extends from the tip inward. On the right lobe, a similar high-intensity white patch occupies the distal third, featuring internal dark pixel mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 100 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary. Each lobe displays approx 10-15 distinct peaks and valleys of varying pixel amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits an overall convex sweep from the median notch to the outer tips, while the leading edge (partially visible) suggests a concave curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of textured, circular high-contrast pixel groupings (barnacles) are concentrated on the extreme distal tips and outer edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent vertical high-intensity linear scratch is visible on the lower section of the left lobe. A smaller, horizontal dark-intensity scratch intersects the white patch on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacles on the fluke tips, creating a multi-layered textured protrusion relative to the smooth surface of the lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular, high-contrast 'islands' of black pigment located within the white distal patches, specifically on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
